fato_historico: 1422: After the brief Gollub War, the Teutonic Knights sign the Treaty of Melno with Poland and Lithuania.

Consider how your steady determination can mend bridges, creating a tranquil environment where your long-term ambitions can flourish with newfound grace and ease.
frase_do_dia: Quiet strength creates the most enduring peace in your journey forward.
